contentText: So much of Scotland’s history has been forged by its relationship to England and by one central question: union or independence? Brexit has given the independence movement new momentum, and with Scottish elections coming up in May, the question is back at the centre of the debating table. In this new episode of "Growing up in Europe", ENTR travelled to Scotland to ask young people where they see the future of their country: in the UK, or on its own?
